messages.author: 2b6ce28377994fcc
messages.subject: regarding C conversion in both forward and reverse strands
parts:
Hi,

Thank so much for this wonderful package, great work!

I used bismark to do mapping and used read.bismark from output sam files. Here is my question, from bismark report the conversion of C were reported from both strands, but from read out of methylkit we only see conversion of C from reverse strand. Could you please help me to understand the differences?

Thanks in advance!
Steve

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: regarding C conversion in both forward and reverse strands
parts:
It is hard to say what could be wrong without seeing the actual sorted bismark SAM file. I guess first is to make sure the file contains alignments on both strands and it is sorted. 

Then, compare the Bismark SAM file with the examples in the package to see if there are any differences in format. There are also more remote possibilities that there are not enough alignments to calculate conversion rate on Forward strand, but this is not very likely. Average conversion rate is calculated for non-CpG bases that have at least 10 reads with phred quality above 20.


Best,
Altuna

messages.subject: Re: regarding C conversion in both forward and reverse strands
parts:
Hi Steve,
Picard can scramble column order for tags in the sam file, samtools sort should be better or unix sort. We had users that had issues with Picard sort before.

Best,
Altuna
